title: cosmos purpureus
intro: Cosmos purpureus, commonly known as the purple cosmos, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the asteraceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Cosmos purpureus include its ability to act as a sedative and antispasmodic, helping to soothe muscle cramps and promote restful sleep. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
